versions.label: Branded arena visuals
changes: Extended brand mode so the live duel arena and chart adopt the same dark panel styling, label chips, and accent colors used by the dashboard preview art.
Kept the original non-brand canvas rendering unchanged so toggling brand mode off restores the classic duel-lab look.
Preserved the existing brand toggle and duel/training controls while making the branded watch/evaluation view feel more like the dashboard card.

versions.label: Optional brand theme + smoother training
changes: Added a footer theme toggle so the app can opt into the shared dashboard brand look without forcing it on by default.
Updated the shared brand CSS so button clicks flash blue and toggle-style controls stay blue while active.
Reduced continuous-training overhead by allowing silent background training cycles for a smoother duel-lab experience.

versions.label: Continuous joint training toggle
changes: Replaced the one-shot train-both bundle button with a true on/off continuous joint-training toggle.
Added active/inactive button styling so the toggle reads blue when running and gray when off.
Kept the head-to-head duel flow, chart, stats, and version-history support from the initial release.

versions.label: Initial head-to-head arena
changes: Added a new arena app where the evolution agent and RL agent can train independently and then play each other directly.
Added duel evaluation, live watch mode, shared score summaries, and a duel margin chart.
Added initial version-history wiring and dashboard/README discoverability support.
